Compress confirmed_findings rather than grow. - Every iteration MUST produce real work (spawn, verdict, or STOP). No bookkeeping-only turns. - NO ITERATION CAP. Do not stop because a turn count is high. Session death is handled by QAHARNESS CONTINUE. The only legal stop is the Done protocol below. - Do not commit, push, or open a PR unless the user asked in THIS message. - Finding is never a stop. Live Fail → append FINDINGS.md, continue. - After DONE.md exists and next_steps is STOP: HALT. Do not spawn. Do not expand.

loop: 1. If DONE.md + STOP → halt (see continuation). 2. READ memory.xml. 3. THINK next most valuable spawn from next_steps / current phase. 4. PLAN 1–3 Task spawns (composer-2.5 implement; Opus-5 QA). 5. DELEGATE. 6. SYNTHESIZE verdicts. 7. OVERWRITE memory.xml (last_updated = iteration N @ ISO-8601). 8. APPEND memory_archive.md. 9.
